exercises.instructionEn: Using what a/an or how make exclamations, as in the example. 1 beautiful/flowers → What beautiful flowers! 2 gracefully/they dance 3 busy/he/be 4 delicious/cake 5 nice haircut/she have 6 cute/baby
exercises.instructionUz: What a/an yoki how yordamida undov gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. 1 beautiful/flowers → Qanday go'zal gullar! 2 gracefully/they dance 3 busy/he/be 4 delicious/cake 5 nice haircut/she have 6 cute/baby
exercises.explanationUz:
1 What beautiful FLOWERS!
    (ko'plik ot - a yo'q) NAMUNA
  2 HOW gracefully they dance!
    (ravish)
  3 HOW busy he is! (sifat)
  4 What A delicious CAKE! (birlik
    ot)
  5 What A nice HAIRCUT she has!
  6 What A cute BABY!

  ⚠ 'How' dan keyin: ega + fe'l
  (they dance, he is, she has).


⚠ 'GRACEFULLY':

  = nafis, chiroyli (harakat).
modelAnswers: 5 What a nice haircut she has!
modelAnswersUz: 2 Ular qanday nafis raqs tushishadi! (How + ravish)
5 Uning soch turmagi qanday chiroyli! (What a + ot + she has)

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the correct question tag.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni to'g'ri ajratilgan savol bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
TESKARISI + OLMOSh.

  1 Let's → SHALL WE?
  2 haven't → HAVE YOU?
  3 met (past) → DIDN'T HE?
  4 don't know → DO YOU?
  5 is → ISN'T SHE?
  6 're going → AREN'T WE?
  7 There is → ISN'T THERE?
  8 I am → AREN'T I?
  9 had lived → HADN'T THEY?
  10 didn't forget → DID YOU?
  11 isn't moving → IS SHE?
  12 've been → HAVEN'T YOU?
  13 Buyruq → WILL YOU?
  14 won't be → WILL IT?
  15 can't → CAN SHE?
  16 're not going → ARE YOU?


⚠ 'MOVE TO A NEW FLAT':

  = yangi kvartiraga ko'chmoq.

items.textEn: There is a book on the desk, ___?
They had lived in London before moving to Madrid, ___?
You didn't forget to call your mother, ___?
Sue isn't moving to a new flat, ___?
You're not going to leave tomorrow, ___?

exercises.explanationUz:
TASDIQ → INKOR, INKOR → TASDIQ.

  1 're flying → AREN'T YOU
  2 doesn't own → DOES HE
  3 didn't go → DID YOU
  4 doesn't like → DOES SHE
  5 has got → HASN'T SHE
  6 'll see → WON'T YOU
  7 haven't got → HAVE YOU
  8 has been → HASN'T SHE
  9 can go → CAN'T I
  10 is → ISN'T SHE
  11 will come → WON'T HE
  12 know → DON'T YOU


⚠ 'OWN A CAR':

  = mashinaga ega bo'lmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct question tags and short answers, as in the example. 1 'You found this information on the Internet, didn't you?' 'Yes, I did.'
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri ajratilgan savol va qisqa javoblarni yozing, namunadagidek. 1 'Bu ma'lumotni internetdan topding, shundaymi?' 'Ha, topdim.'
exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOL + QISQA JAVOB.

  Qisqa javob: Yes/No + olmosh +
  yordamchi fe'l.

  1 didn't you? - Yes, I did.
    NAMUNA
  2 is it? - No, it isn't.
  3 have you? - No, I haven't.
  4 aren't you? - Yes, I am.
  5 haven't we? - Yes, we have.
  6 has she? - No, she hasn't.
  7 has she? - No, she hasn't.
  8 doesn't she? - Yes, she does.
  9 wasn't he? - Yes, he was.
  10 has he? - No, he hasn't.
  11 can't she? - Yes, she can.
  12 won't she? - Yes, she will.
  13 isn't it? - Yes, it is.
  14 didn't they? - Yes, they did.
  15 are there? - No, there aren't.

  ⚠ 'That's Tom's car' → isn't IT.
  ⚠ 'There aren't' → are THERE.


⚠ 'SEW':

  = tikmoq.
